rationale: Builds on the staged reverse-tail recurrence baseline with a compact structural change: each recurrent tail block now blends the global decoder-output anchor with that block's own first-pass tail state via a tiny learned tail_anchor_mix control. This targets the still-promising reverse-tail anchor family without adding a new head, changing eval, or spending bytes on broader shape churn. The edit stays compile-stable, keeps the final exact int8+zlib path intact, and preserves the near-cap recurrent-tail/export regime while giving earlier recurrent tail blocks a more local refresh signal than the single shared anchor.
title: Reverse-Tail Local Anchor Blend
